eventMetadata.context_description: The New York Knicks hold a commanding 3-0 series lead over the Philadelphia 76ers in the Eastern Conference semifinals after Jalen Brunson's 33-point performance and stout defense sealed a hard-fought Game 3 victory two days ago. Philadelphia faces elimination in Game 4 tonight at home, but Joel Embiid remains questionable with lingering right hip and ankle soreness after sitting out Game 2, severely testing the Sixers' frontcourt depth amid Paul George's inconsistent playoff form. For the Knicks, OG Anunoby (hamstring) and Josh Hart (thumb) are questionable per latest injury reports, with Mitchell Robinson probable after illness, potentially thinning New York's wing rotation despite home-court advantage shifting back to MSG if series extends. Traders weigh Knicks' momentum and recent dominance against mutual injury risks in this high-stakes matchup.

eventMetadata.context_description: Finland's Linda Lampenius and Pete Parkkonen lead trader consensus to win Eurovision 2026 with "Liekinheitin" at 46.9% implied probability, bolstered by their UMK victory and glowing first rehearsals in host city Vienna, where live violin staging has generated strong jury bait buzz and viral clips. Denmark's Søren Torpegaard Lund with haunting ballad "Før vi går hjem" surged to 12.6% after overtaking Greece in bookie odds last week, fueled by energetic Melodi Grand Prix win and fresh stage previews. Greece's Akylas holds 12.3% on "Ferto"'s Sing for Greece momentum and pop appeal, though recent rehearsal breakdowns highlight staging tweaks. With semi-finals kicking off May 12 and final May 16, televote volatility and bloc voting could spark upsets among the 37 entrants.
